long_biography.plain_text:
Trading entrepreneur Jascha Rudolphi used relationships with Chinese suppliers to enter the protective-equipment market as shortages developed in Europe. He and his business partner reserved aircraft while air freight was scarce. They arranged testing in China to screen purchases before shipment.

Rudolphi serves as the sole registered director of Amira Labs in Zurich. The organisation was created to provide space for people exploring new technologies and changes in working life. Its stated approach gives participants freedom to pursue ideas without predetermined project goals, rather than promising a particular commercial product.
